**WHO WE ARE:**

[**Aviatrix®**](https://www.aviatrix.com/) is the cloud network security company trusted by more than 500 of the world’s leading enterprises. As cloud infrastructures become more complex and costly, the Aviatrix Cloud Network Security platform gives companies back the power, control, security, and simplicity they need to modernize their cloud strategies. Aviatrix is the only secure networking solution built specifically for the cloud, that ensures companies are ready for AI and what’s next. Combined with the [Aviatrix Certified Engineer (ACE) Program](https://aviatrix.com/ace/), the industry’s leading secure multicloud networking certification, Aviatrix unifies cloud, networking, and security teams and unlocks greater potential across any cloud.​

**ABOUT THE ROLE: Director, Marketing Operations**

Aviatrix is seeking a motivated and experienced Director, Marketing Operations to lead the Marketing Operations team. This role will report directly to our Chief Marketing Officer and will be responsible for managing our marketing tech stack, overseeing and optimizing marketing processes, and driving efficiency across marketing functions in alignment with business objectives. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in marketing operations, a strong understanding of technology and data/analytics, and a passion for driving results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Strategic Planning:

- Collaborate with the marketing leadership team to align marketing operations with overall business goals.
- Develop and implement a comprehensive marketing operations strategy and process that enhances Marketing efficiency and effectiveness.

Marketing Technology Management:

- Oversee the selection, implementation, optimization, and integration of marketing technologies (e.g. CRM systems, marketing automation, analytics tools, AI tools, etc.) to streamline operations and maximize efficiency.
- Evangelizes the use of AI (generative and agentic) to create scale across all marketing functions
- Manage relationships with technology vendors and stay abreast of industry trends

Data Analysis and Reporting:

- Establish metrics, KPIs, and dashboards to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and initiatives.
- Analyze marketing performance data to provide insights and recommendations for optimizing marketing efforts/strategies based on performance metrics.
- Ensure the accuracy and completeness of marketing data, implementing data governance and quality control measures.

Team Leadership and Collaboration:

- Lead, mentor, train and develop a high-performing marketing operations team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
- Stay apprised of industry trends (especially AI) and share knowledge as well as, best practices with the team to foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, IT, finance, product, and other relevant teams to ensure alignment and integration of marketing operations strategies.
- Work closely with the IT team to address technical issues and enhance systems integrations.

Budget Management:

- Collaborate with Finance and Marketing leadership to develop and manage marketing budgets and forecasting, allocate resources effectively, and optimize spending to achieve desired outcomes.
- Monitor spending to ensure optimal allocation of resources and return on investment.

Demand Generation Ops:

- Design and refine lead capture, scoring, and nurturing workflows that align with industry best practices and support efficient lead conversion and robust pipeline generation.
- Work very closely with revenue ops to track marketing-sourced pipeline generation and conversion.
- Act as an operations lead for the Demand Generation team.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field (Master's degree preferred); or equivalent combination of education and experience.
- 10+ years of experience in Marketing Operations with at least 5 years in a leadership role at a B2B SaaS organization.
- Proven track record in marketing operations and driving efficiency/effectiveness.
- Strong understanding of the marketing technology landscape (including marketing automation, CRM, analytics, etc), analytics and best practices.
- Hands-on and proven experience in architecting and developing foundational marketing technologies (e.g. Marketo, Salesforce, Drift, ABM, Gifting, etc.)
- Excellent proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and using insights to drive decision-making.
- Demonstrated leadership experience in managing, motivating and developing a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Exceptional collaboration, and project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strategic thinker with the ability to translate strategies into actionable plans.

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is **$192,865 - $226,900** \+ benefits + 401(k) match + equity and is bonus eligible. The pay range is determined by the role, work location, job-related skills, level, experience and relevant education. The range displayed is applicable only for new hires for the listed position located in the US. Your Talent Advisor can share more details regarding salary ranges, benefits, and equity for your location during the hiring process.

**BENEFITS**

**US**: We cover 100% of employee premiums and 88% of dependent(s) premiums for medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) match, short and long-term disability, life/AD&D insurance, $1,000/year education reimbursement, and a flexible vacation policy.

**Outside the US:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package which, (subject to regional variations) could include pension, private medical for you and dependents, generous holiday allowance, life assurance, long-term disability, annual wellbeing stipend

Your total compensation package will be based on job-related knowledge, education, certifications and location, per our aligned ranges.

**WE WANT TO INCLUDE YOU**

We embrace the fact that not everyone’s journey took the same route or started at the same place. If your experience doesn’t quite meet the requirements but the opportunity excites you and you believe you could be great, don’t let that hold you back from applying. Tell us what you CAN bring and what makes you special.

Aviatrix is a community where everyone's career can grow and we want to help you achieve your goals and be “your best YOU,” however that looks. If you're seeking an opportunity where you can be excited to start work every morning with enthusiastic people, make a real difference and be part of something amazing then let’s talk. We want to get to know you and how we could grow together.
